title: Name a theme colour
summary: A theme variable adds a design choice that Tailwind can turn into utilities.
introduction: A theme variable adds a design choice that Tailwind can turn into utilities. Your task: Add a second named colour to the theme.
learningObjectives: Add a second named colour to the theme.
Explain the example for name a theme colour

blocks.text: A theme variable adds a design choice that Tailwind can turn into utilities. The --color prefix creates colour utilities.

These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.

blocks.title: Name a theme colour

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: Tailwind's `@theme` block names design values. A `--color-...` name creates matching colour utilities.

blocks.text: After rebuilding, classes such as bg-leaf use the new green colour.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Define theme values in the CSS input file. Putting @theme in an HTML class attribute will not work.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a second named colour to the theme.
